facts_of_case: The Petitioner was convicted for an offence under Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act and sentenced to undergo 1 year S.I and was directed to pay a sum of Rs.25,00,000/- towards compensation to the complainant within 3 months i/d 3 months S.I.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the accused to prove that the cheque was lost and not dishonoured.
legal_principles.held: Therefore, the learned counsel appearing for the respondent submitted that the finding of the Courts below after analysing the fact and law has to be confirmed.
